Gujarat University Hosts Polish Ayurveda Practitioners

Parul University in Gujarat hosted 24 Ayurveda practitioners from Poland. The practitioners participated in Panchakarma and Ayurveda programs at the university. The event focused on international exchange in traditional Indian medicine.
